items.text: Each gathered value meets one binary at first contact, value here or value at another file, and nothing is waiting for any other thing: a value its file holds is entered there, a value whose concept another file names goes to that file's gathering-value, and a parting of two sixes or two namings is said apart where it stands.
items.from: v393E: nothing is waiting for any other thing
